checked_at_note: Session research time in UTC; checks completed during this session.
scope: Public GitHub repositories, default-branch indexed code, public issues and pull requests, with candidate source inspection. No private repository findings included.
conclusion: No public MoonBit Android AXML/binary-XML decoding library, offline CLI, or identified in-progress issue/PR was found by these searches. This is a search result, not proof no project exists.
limitations: GitHub code search indexes accessible default branches and can lag; no private or unindexed repositories are covered.
GitHub search is case-insensitive and often matches substrings. All 27 AXML code hits were fetched and inspected, rather than treated as Android AXML implementations.
Repository connector exposes returned_count, not total_count. No unreturned pages are assumed absent.
Issues/PR searches can hit comments or broad indexed text; broad results were triaged, then title/body AXML+MoonBit queries returned zero.
